##### Project general facts

Al Multaqa Avenue is a mixed-use development within the Mirdif Hills community, developed by Dubai Investments Real Estate, offering a blend of residential, hospitality, and retail components. The project includes a selection of studios and 1-bedroom apartments, alongside serviced apartments, a hotel, and a variety of retail and dining outlets. Designed with a cohesive architectural style, the buildings feature modern lines and a neutral palette of grey and beige tones, reflecting a contemporary yet comfortable living environment.

The development creates a vibrant and self-sufficient community with a wide range of lifestyle amenities. Residents have access to cafés, restaurants, and retail spaces within the complex, as well as hospitality services provided by the on-site hotel. The integration of residential and commercial elements ensures convenience and enhances everyday living, making it an attractive option for both residents and investors.

The residences are designed with modern interiors and functional layouts, offering comfortable living spaces complemented by quality finishes. The apartments are delivered fully finished, with equipped kitchens that provide practicality for daily use. The residences are offered unfurnished.

##### Location description and benefits

Mirdif Hills is an extensive and vibrant development located in the heart of Dubai, United Arab Emirates. Spread over a vast area, Mirdif Hills is designed to provide a balanced and integrated living environment. The development features a mix of low-rise buildings, townhouses, and apartments, offering various housing options to cater to different preferences and lifestyles. The architectural design of Mirdif Hills reflects a modern aesthetic combined with elements inspired by the local heritage, creating a unique blend of contemporary and traditional influences.

Within Mirdif Hills, residents and visitors can enjoy a wide array of amenities and services. These include retail outlets, restaurants, cafes, and entertainment venues, providing convenient access to daily essentials and recreational activities. The community also features landscaped parks, open spaces, and pedestrian-friendly areas, promoting a sense of community and encouraging outdoor activities.

Mirdif Hills is known for its attention to detail and commitment to quality. The development showcases state-of-the-art infrastructure, exceptional construction standards, and meticulous attention to interior design. Residents can expect modern amenities, spacious living areas, and high-quality finishes, creating a comfortable and luxurious living environment.
